interpretation: A valid REA summary and complete evidence bundle were produced for the selected source scope. It found 86 findings in nine parsed files, with zero skipped files or parse failures. Summary view coverage is complete (98/98 entries), but application and semantic analysis coverage is partial and 14 inventoried files were outside the selected analysis. Findings are analyzer output, not a protection or security verdict. The generated production bundle remains unanalyzed successfully; the prior whole-bundle timeout record remains in evidence-summary.json.
